equipment: Cones (To mark the Vaults and boundary lines)
rules: The gym is divided into two halves. Each team has a Vault containing beanbags and a Jail mat in the corner of their side.
Players are safe on their own half but can be tagged by the defense when crossing into enemy territory.
If tagged in enemy territory, the player must go to the enemy's Jail mat.
Players making it safely to the Vault can choose to steal ONE beanbag OR rescue ONE teammate from Jail per trip.
Rescued players get a free, safe walk back to their half. If a player is tagged while carrying a beanbag, the beanbag is returned and the player goes to Jail.
If a tie occurs on the center line, it is resolved instantly with Rock, Paper, Scissors.

key_terms.definition: The tactical decision between attempting to steal a beanbag or rescuing a captured teammate.
Assigning specific duties such as attackers, vault defenders, and jail guards before the round begins.

unit_plan.discussion: How did your team balance the need for offense (stealing) with defense (protecting the vault)?

activities.name: Vault Raiders
activities.overview: Teams compete to clear out the opposing vault while defending their own, requiring constant communication and tactical adjustments.
